bio: Margaret was the wife of Christopher Youngs of Southwold, Suffolk, England, and survived him. Her will, made on 27 October 1630 as "Margaret Youngs late wife of Christopher Youngs deceased of Southwold", divided her household goods among her six children, John, Joseph, Christopher, Mary, Margaret and Martha, and named her sons John and Joseph as executors. She was buried at Southwold on 5 November 1630. She is placed as John's 12th-great-grandmother, but on present evidence the Youngs line of descent is unproven.

researchNotes: Youngs Family (1907) prints the will of 'Margaret Youngs late wife of Christopher Youngs deceased of Southwold', dated 27 Oct 1630, proved 8 Jan 1630/1 (Arch. Suff. Ipswich), dividing her household stuff among her six children John, Joseph, Christopher, Mary, Margaret and Martha, with sons John and Joseph as executors. She was buried at Southwold on 5 Nov 1630 ([R4-S1]). Not ancestral on present evidence.
summary: Widow of Christopher Youngs of Southwold, Suffolk, who died in 1630; placed as John's 12th-great-grandmother, though the Youngs descent is unproven.
